title: The first rain of fall
logline: The first real rain of October on the flats, from the tailgate: the mud pocked, the channels filling, the pup standing in it with his face up. The page's whole year turns on one shower.

panels.composition: Mudflats in the first heavy rain of fall seen from a station wagon's tailgate, the mud pocked with drops, a small three-legged dog standing in it with its face turned up.
